call_dispositions.description: The caller wants a price or a quote for new work, or asked for an estimate to be sent. If they only asked how an estimate they already have is going, use message.
The caller wants to book, move or cancel a visit, a measurement or an appointment, including a visit needed to give a quote.
Something is being damaged or is unsafe right now and needs attention today, such as a leak, fire, electrical, gas or structural problem. Choose this before any other outcome that also fits.
The caller complained or was upset about the work, a delay, the service or a charge, and it is not an urgent hazard.

The owner still has something to check or a call to return, but no outcome above fits: a question about how existing work or an estimate is going, a partner or supplier passing on a message, or a request to be called back.
Nothing is left for the owner to do: the caller only needed the information they got or only said thanks, and nobody needs to call back.
A sales, advertising, survey or automated call, including someone trying to sell the business a product or service.
The caller meant to reach someone else, or said they dialed by mistake and had nothing to pass on.
